title: Prescribed-qbot retention-resolution sweep
question: How much additional derivative-consistent retention/capacity resolution is required to recover the analytical prescribed-qbot Newton path without reverting theta and C to full analytical evaluation?
frozen_case: B01:wet, bottom_mode=2, qbot=1e-6 cm/day, dt=0.01 day
conductivity: F-AHL11 independent K support fixed at abs logK <=3e-4

retention_capacity.representation: cubic Hermite z=logit(Se), C from exact derivative of same interpolant

decision_rule: Select the loosest prospectively tested theta error limit that restores the analytical 2-iteration/2-backtracking path. If neither does, redesign the retention error metric rather than extending an arbitrary density sweep.
